notes.title: Minor Update Today!
notes.notes:
We put up a minor update today that will fix a cursor issue with Windows 10 and a fix for an obscure crash.  

Release Notes: 

1) Win10 Cursor fix (from Adam Johnson and Joseph Davies - thank you!)
2) DirectMusic disabled
3) Version displayed in the title of the game window (if in windowed mode)

notes.title: Myst 25th Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
URU: Complete Chronicles
Myst 25th Anniversary Release
Steam Edition

Thank you for your patience while we were getting this update for URU: Complete Chronicles ready for Steam!  Thanks too for your support of our games.

We have been working to ready all of the games in the Myst series for the 25th Anniversary of Myst, which happens later this month. Most of the games in the series required compatibility updates, and URU:CC was no exception.  

Should you have something you would like to report regarding URU: Complete Chronicles, please contact us directly at support@cyan.com. We would be happy to assist you.

We hope you enjoy your time in URU :)

Thank you!
The Cyan Worlds Team

Release Notes:

Windows 10 compatibility update
Fixed v-sync issues
Fixed mouse issues
Minor graphical fixes
Teledahn crash fixed

URU: Complete Chronicles is now available in 3 languages: English, French, and German! To access language selection, right-click on the game in your Library, select Properties, select the ‘Language tab’, and then select the language option of your choice from the drop-down menu.

Replaced invalid URL links in URU setup window

If your game is not playing properly after the update (e.g. no text appears in the URU setup window), it may be necessary to clear the Download cache.  To do this, select Settings from the nav bar Steam menu, select Downloads, and click on ‘Clear Download Cache.’

Known Issues:

The message that appears in the URU setup window is in English only.
